UMN facial weakness: affects contralateral lower face but spares entire forehead
- Due to bilateral cortical innervation of forehead
- Entire forehead can still wrinkle
- Able to close ipsilateral eye weakly (although may not be able to bury lashes)
- Lesions above facial nerve nuclei: cortical/subcortical, corona radiata, internal capsule, descending corticobulbar fibers, brainstem
LMN facial weakness: affects entire ipsilateral face
- Ipsilateral forehead cannot wrinkle, stays smooth
- Ipsilateral eye open wide, cannot close eyelid (vs. an oculomotor nerve (CN III) lesion, which causes ptosis)
- Bell's palsy, parotid gland tumour
- Lesion at or below facial nerve nuclei: nuclei in pons, cranial cavity, middle ear, peripheral nerve distribution
